build_moriio_connector: build a MoRIIO KV connector instance with vLLM config and scheduler or worker role for distributed KV cache transfer
create_moriio_handshake: create a MoRIIO handshake between local and remote engines to exchange KV cache metadata via ZMQ
run_kv_cache_register: register local KV cache tensors with MoRIIO engine for remote read and write operations
